title: Data Link Layer
markdown:
The **Data Link Layer** (Layer 2) transforms the physical layer's raw transmission facility into a reliable link, making the physical layer appear error-free to the upper layer.

### Primary Responsibilities

- **Framing** — Divides the bit stream received from the network layer into manageable data units called **frames**.
- **Physical Addressing** — Adds a header containing the physical (MAC) address of the sender and receiver for hop-to-hop delivery.
- **Flow Control** — Prevents a fast sender from overwhelming a slow receiver.
- **Error Control** — Adds a trailer (**T₂**) containing CRC bits to detect corrupted frames and retransmit lost frames.
- **Access Control** — Determines which device has control over a shared medium at any given time (MAC sublayer).
